scientific_provenance.interpretation: The exact scientific recipe is embedded directly in each NetCDF. Configuration hashes are therefore not required to reconstruct the recipe and should not be reintroduced as redundant legacy metadata.

instrument_lineage_machine_readability.reason: Station_Profile plus the embedded exact station catalog preserve the lineage for human reconstruction, but the normalized profile/calibration identifiers were not directly searchable as global attributes in these products.

current_code_fix.behavior: Derived products normalize explicit source Station_Profile to station_profile_id and materialize instrument_calibration_id only when the named profile exists in the loaded station catalog; no date-based profile inference is performed.

notes: No software/data license is selected by this audit; licensing remains a deliberate governance decision.
A CF Conventions attribute must not be added until actual CF compliance is reviewed rather than assumed.
Citation/contact/title metadata should be designed as stable release metadata rather than copied ad hoc into scientific code.

environment_reproducibility.interpretation: Source-code content identity and exact YAML recipes are present, but bit-for-bit environment recreation still requires a released/locked environment artifact outside or alongside the product.
